column1: # Expected differences between two corpus captures.
# The diff gates:  a difference not matched by a row here fails the
# comparison.  That is the point -- a comparison whose negative case
# cannot occur proves nothing -- so every row is a claim that someone
# has to defend, and a row with no reason is not a row.
# Five tab-separated columns:
#   pair      which two captures.  theirs:ours-before is adoption --
#             what RGW answers over a tree it has not converted,
#             against what NooBaa answered for the same tree.
#             ours-before:ours-after is conversion.
#   artifact  manifest | inventory | run
#   key       manifest:  the field, third column, `*` globs a suffix
#             inventory: xattr:<name>, mode, owner, or size
#             run:       the axis whose artifacts are absent entirely
#   class     persists  differs, and still will after conversion
#             vanishes  differs now, must be identical after
#             absent    one side produced nothing to compare
#             filtered  not a difference;  the writer must drop it
#   reason    why, in one line.  Required.
# NEVER key a row on a literal value from their side.  Their ETag and
# version id embed an mtime whose low 8 bits are lost to a double in
# their C++ (fs_napi.cpp:360), one `int64_t` from being fixed;  a row
# that names the string breaks on their next release instead of
# failing honestly.  Key on the field.
# Rows marked PROVISIONAL were derived from the NooBaa capture plus the
# mapping in docs/NOOBAA_WRITE_SURFACE.md.  `capture/rgw` does not
# exist yet (C2b), so no row below has been confirmed by an actual
# diff.  The first real run is expected to move some of them.
# ---- adoption:  theirs vs ours-before ------------------------------
# In base profile we add nothing to their tree, so the inventory
# should be *identical* here.  An inventory difference in this pair is
# a defect, not an expected difference, and only the bucket's own
# adoption marker is permitted.
theirs:ours-before
column5: PROVISIONAL only where NooBaa stored no user.content_md5. WITH rgw_non_md5_etag the values differ in the mtime's low 8 bits, which we do not reproduce (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-09); WITHOUT it -- the default -- we MD5 the object and the values are unrelated. The row cannot be read without knowing which

column1: # Listed so the first diff has something to correct, with no class
# asserted.  Each needs a measurement, not an argument.
#   manifest  mode / inventory mode   C1 normalizes permissions, and
#       their files are 0660 here.  What conversion writes has not been
#       measured against a tree they wrote.
#   manifest  *.refused vs *.accepted  a refusal is encoded in the
#       *field name*, so one gateway refusing and the other accepting
#       shows up as a removed line and an added line rather than a
#       changed value.  The format, not the list, has to answer this.
# Checked and NOT a problem:  version.mtime-<...>-ino-<...>.* field
# names align, because NooBaa stores every version id in
# user.noobaa.version_id -- the current version included -- and we
# forward the stored string (NB_KEYS, xattr_strategy.cc:131) rather
# than recomputing it.  One tree, one set of ids, all three captures.
